Internship Details 
Location: Dublin
Duration: 3 months 
Start date: 1st June 2027
End date: 31st August 2027
Number of open roles: 2 Internship positions available 
Eligibility: You’re currently in the penultimate year of your Bachelor’s degree, graduating in 2029.
Hybrid: 3 days per week in the office, 2 days working from home
 Annual Pay: €33,000, pro rata for the 3-month internship
Order Management serves as a core business partner within the finance organisation focused on the analysis of data from several sources and the development of scalable solutions to ensure accurate booking and reporting of revenue. We provide world-class support to our customers through collaboration across the organisation. Our team promotes a dynamic culture, fostering personal growth and career development.
What you’ll do
Develop your knowledge of Adobe’s Digital Media and Digital Experience sales models, including enterprise subscription and term licensing programmes.
As you build your knowledge and confidence in the role, take on primary support for rest of world channel and enterprise accounts, including order and PO processing, returns and credits, issue resolution and escalation management.
Use Salesforce, Dynamics and SAP to process enterprise opportunities and contracts, supporting accurate invoicing and revenue recognition.
Actively review sales pipeline and deal information to anticipate potential booking or customer experience issues and work with the team to resolve them during the deal process.
Conduct weekly reconciliations and other checks to support accurate revenue booking and reporting, using SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with teams across different regions on data management, innovation and process improvements, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency and streamline ways of working.
Work cross-functionally with teams across Adobe, including Deal Desk, Revenue Assurance, Sales Operations, Credit, Legal, Sales and Finance, as well as enterprise customers and partners.
Provide additional support during busy periods, including month and quarter-end, where required.
What you need to succeed
Currently studying towards a Bachelor’s degree in a business, finance, numerate or related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Curious, adaptable and collaborative, with a willingness to learn.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with good attention to detail.
Able to organise your workload and manage changing priorities.
Confident building relationships and working with different teams.
An interest in business operations and commercial processes.
Experience with, or an interest in learning, tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, SQL, Alteryx or SAP.
Any relevant internship, placement, part-time work or university project experience is a plus undefined.
What to expect from the recruitment process:  Our selection process typically consists of the stages as follows. 
Pre-Recorded Video Interview - A brief 10-minute video submission  Assessment Day (Role-Dependent) - For certain roles, candidates may be invited to an in-person Assessment Day.

If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
